reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in his #central-team thread: Marrow Agrisupply is at 40 seats on SLA Tier 1.

- **Where 40 comes from:** the affiliate amendment, signed 2025-10-02 and effective 2025-10-15.
- **2026 renewal:** it was signed 22 Apr 2026, took effect 1 May 2026 and runs through 30 Apr 2027. It left Marrow Agrisupply's seat count unchanged.
- **Account page:** it still shows 40.

I also flagged that Tobias posted 382 seats in the channel on Oct 14, but nothing on file supports it. When I asked him for the paperwork, nothing came back in the channel. I suggested Hollis check with him before putting anything other than 40 on the sheet.

Seat counts aren't finance figures, so this was fine to share in the team channel. I left out pricing.
